summary: The Seru Citadel is the seat of ultimate authority within Sanctus Seru, where elite forces reside and Seru’s doctrine is enforced with absolute precision.
history: Constructed as the central command fortress after the schism with Katta Castrum.
The Grand Hall serves as the ceremonial center of Seru’s military power.
Elite Quarters house the most loyal and disciplined soldiers.
The Command Sanctum oversees all operations across Sanctus Seru.
The Throne Chamber is reserved for Seru’s highest leadership and judgment.
